new_value: Fixed in 3ee6524. Confirmed live before changing anything: spiffe_id.rs:97 read prefix.ends_with("via") and the adjacent prefix == "via" arm was dead. Predicate is now prefix == "via" || prefix.ends_with("/via"), and mutation testing confirms BOTH arms are now load-bearing (dropping the bare-via arm kills via_alone_is_a_prefix; restoring the old suffix test kills a_segment_merely_ending_in_via_is_not_a_provenance_marker). Scope note the bead did not have: SpiffeId had NO test module at all, so five tests were added, with SPEC-HIA.md:69 as the oracle and the spec's own example URIs from lines 74, 77 and 653 quoted verbatim, plus the user/{sub}/via/oidc-cached that persona-attestors/src/oidc.rs:80 actually mints. Reachability is narrower than the bead implies -- provenance() has no callers in the workspace today -- but it is public API whose doc stated the contract precisely, and a SpiffeId parsed from a URI this daemon did not mint is the case that matters.
